**Product Title:**  
SmartFit Pro X1 Smartwatch

**Short Marketing Description:**  
Stay connected, track your wellness, and elevate your everyday routine with the SmartFit Pro X1 Smartwatch. Featuring a vibrant 1.9-inch AMOLED display, Bluetooth calling, and advanced health and fitness tracking, it’s designed to keep up with your active lifestyle. With up to 7 days of battery life and IP68 waterproof protection, the SmartFit Pro X1 delivers reliable performance from work to workout.

**Key Features:**  
- 1.9-inch AMOLED display for crisp, clear viewing  
- Bluetooth calling for convenient hands-free communication  
- Up to 7-day battery life for lasting use  
- Heart-rate monitoring to support wellness goals  
- Sleep tracking for better rest insights  
- IP68 waterproof design for everyday durability  
- Fitness activity tracking to help monitor movement and progress  

**Promotional Tagline:**  
Smart style. Smarter living.
